quests.instruction: TAP THE TARGET WORD IN THE ROLLING CRT STREAM
quests.passage: [Vent 171-1] Hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor release superheated minerals into the icy sea, creating a dark sanctuary for life.
quests.hint: Scan the rolling lines for the word meaning hot deep-sea vents releasing minerals. (Diving calibration index 171-1)
quests.explanation: Hydrothermal vents are extreme mineral channels on the deep ocean floor. [Verified by Radar Scanning Unit 171].

quests.instruction: TAP THE TARGET WORD IN THE ROLLING CRT STREAM
quests.passage: [Bacteria 171-2] In complete darkness, specialized bacteria thrive by performing chemosynthesis to convert toxic sulfide compounds into organic food.
quests.hint: Scan for the specific chemical conversion process used by deep bacteria. (Diving calibration index 171-2)
quests.explanation: Chemosynthesis represents chemical-based food generation in dark ocean depths. [Verified by Radar Scanning Unit 171].

quests.instruction: TAP THE TARGET WORD IN THE ROLLING CRT STREAM
quests.passage: [Forest 171-3] Giant kelp forests are among the most dynamic ecosystems, growing upward toward the solar rays at incredible daily speeds.
quests.hint: Scan for the ecological communities formed by giant kelp structures. (Diving calibration index 171-3)
quests.explanation: Ecosystems represent interactive communities of living species. [Verified by Radar Scanning Unit 171].

quests.instruction: TAP THE TARGET WORD IN THE ROLLING CRT STREAM
quests.passage: [Biolum 172-1] Almost ninety percent of all deep-sea creatures have evolved bioluminescence as a chemical defense mechanism against predators.
quests.hint: Scan for the biological light generation mechanism used for dark defense. (Diving calibration index 172-1)
quests.explanation: Bioluminescence is cold light generated chemicals inside organism cells. [Verified by Radar Scanning Unit 172].

quests.instruction: TAP THE TARGET WORD IN THE ROLLING CRT STREAM
quests.passage: [Coral 172-2] Unlike tropical reefs, cold deep-sea corals grow slowly because they do not host symbiotic algae for photosynthesis.
quests.hint: Scan for the mutually beneficial relationship indicator among coral organisms. (Diving calibration index 172-2)
quests.explanation: Symbiotic partnerships define cooperative survival relationships between organisms. [Verified by Radar Scanning Unit 172].
